utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Ira, what time’s the repair drive starting, and do you need any tools brought along?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It starts at 10, and if you can bring a screwdriver and a pair of gloves, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring a screwdriver and gloves. See you at 10.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — if the repair drive needs any tools, I’m happy to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus — that’s really kind. I might need to check what’s missing first, since I’ve been a bit out of it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No rush at all — just let me know what you need when you’ve had a chance to check, and I can help track it down.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right—the repair drive. I haven’t heard the latest yet, but I’m keeping an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the logistics too—once I know the time and drop-off details, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Pia — I appreciate it. I’ll keep my ears open too and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great—could you check the repair drive location and let me know if it’s by the back garage or the front shed?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll check it and let you know which one it’s by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling folks about it now—want me to swing by your place with the details?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. If you could drop the details by, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll swing by with the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m getting the repair drive organized, and I’d love your help spreading the word. Let me know which houses you can reach, and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — if you can cover the east side, I’ll take the west and post the flyers by tonight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to double-check the details first—what exactly needs to be repaired, and when is the drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late to this, but I can help check the details. What’s on the repair list, and when are you thinking of running the drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — I’m checking the repair list and timing now, and I’ll send the details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be a huge help, Faye — thank you. I’ll keep the schedule centered around pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — send me the current repair schedule and I’ll work around the school times.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together pretty nicely—folks have been donating tools and a few people already signed up to help on Saturday. I can fill you in on the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great—what time should I show up, and is there anything you still need?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what’s the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: It’s about the repair drive, right? I just want to make sure I’ve got the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, just the neighborhood repair drive — collecting fixes and volunteers for shared stuff. What part do you want me to clarify?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey—I'm a bit scattered today. I think we should make a quick list of the broken things and I’ll figure out the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good—I’ll jot down what I see and bring it to you.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and make sure we’re stocked for it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll remind everyone about the repair drive and keep the plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m hearing the repair drive’s getting organized well, so I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit behind; what do you need me to know?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just that it’s coming together nicely — I’ll let you know if I hear any sign-up or supply updates while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to check on that. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We still need to sort the supplies and line up a few more volunteers. I can check in later and repeat the plan to anyone who missed it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I’ll sort the supplies and ask around for a couple more volunteers. If you check in later, I’ll be ready to hear the plan again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I can help if you remind me what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan to neighbors and send updates as things change.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Leo — I appreciate that. Just keep me posted and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I can bring over my tool kit and whatever else you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s keep it simple: bring the toolkit, and I’ll set out the repair list and coffee.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll bring the toolkit by in the morning. See you then, Eli.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great, Mara — could you help me spread the word and maybe bring a few tools if you’ve got them? I’ll keep you posted on the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and check what tools I can bring. Just let me know the time and place when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d be happy to help bring folks together for the repair drive—what’s the latest on what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We still need a final count of the damaged items, plus the drop-off spot and timing confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it—I’ll check on the final count and confirm the drop-off spot and timing. I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m putting the repair drive details together now, and I’ll make sure everyone on the block knows where to bring things.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Rosa — I’ll check what supplies we already have and set aside anything useful for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — that’ll help a lot. I’ll send around a quick list of what we still need once I finish the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely — I can ask around for pickup help, small repair folks, and a few good drop-off spots for supplies. I’ll keep it simple and send you what I find.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell. Can you send me the pickup help and drop-off spots first?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely — I’ll send those first and keep an eye out for repair help too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I heard there was a repair drive going on—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s still moving along—I'm trying to line up the pickup and drop-off times around the school schedule. If you want, I can share the latest details once they’re confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, just send me the confirmed times when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Cleo — I’m getting the repair drive organized now, and I’d love your help if you’re available.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you mean the repair drive for the neighborhood stuff, right? I can help, but I want to make sure I’ve got the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, that’s the one — the neighborhood repair drive for fixing up shared things. I’m gathering the list now, and I’d really appreciate your help.
